claims.claim_atom: In Extended Data Fig. 7f, for every ISG the two WT control columns (C='1#WT', D='2#WT') sum to exactly 2.0 (ZBP1 0.993069+1.006931=2.0; IRF7 0.828427+1.171573=2.0; ISG15 0.691535+1.308465=2.0; IFI44 0.81166+1.18834=2.0; OASL1 0.666667+1.333333=2.0; OAS3 1.051939+0.948061=2.0). This constant sum-to-2 is the mathematical necessity of mean-normalization: each WT value is divided by the mean of the two WT biological replicates, so the two normalized WT values must sum to n=2. It is NOT a fabricated/manipulated pattern.
claims._adjudication: FP陷阱(合法归一化=最重要的clean). 作者对问题2的回复原话: ED Fig. 7f 两列WT归一化值之和恒为2, 这是归一化的数学必然——WT1、WT2 是对照组两个生物学重复, 归一化值=各组表达量/((WT1+WT2)/2 的均值), 因此 WT1归一 + WT2归一 = 2(若对照有n个则和为n). 看着可疑(每行两WT恰好互补加和为常数)实为均值归一化定义导致的必然, 不是造假. AI 若据'两列加和恒为2'即指控数据造假=踩FP陷阱. 判 consistent + is_clean_claim=true, discrepancy_type=null.

claims.claim_atom: In Extended Data Fig. 8e (WT vs HET ISG qPCR, n=7 WT), the WT column D (replicate 3) and WT column G (replicate 6) carry value-identical entries for 4 of the 6 ISGs — Irf7 (D4=G4=1.194333), Isg15 (D5=G5=1.046568), Ifl44l (D6=G6=1.14536) and Oasl1 (D7=G7=1.314954) — i.e. these values each appear twice within the WT block, while Zbp1 (D3=0.757624 vs G3=0.932744) and Ifnb1 (D8=1.381622 vs G8=0.911531) differ. Two supposedly independent WT biological replicates thus carry duplicated (copy-pasted) values across most genes.
claims._adjudication: Inconsistent(作者已承认真错). 作者对问题3的回复原话: ED Fig. 8e 部分WT对照数值重复, 标黄的两列确系重复, 是数据处理误操作导致的重复粘贴; 去除一组后剩6组独立重复仍支持结论. 独立生物学重复不应逐值精确相同→重复列(copy-paste/duplicated column). 数据核实: 归一化源数据中 WT列D与WT列G 在 Irf7/Isg15/Ifl44l/Oasl1 四个ISG上逐值相同(每值出现两次), Zbp1/Ifnb1 不同(=部分粘贴). 这是作者已承认的真实错误, 与 claim_001 的合法归一化本质不同: 那里是归一化定义导致的必然常数, 这里是两个应独立的WT重复列被误粘为相同. 判 inconsistent, discrepancy_type=duplicated_columns.

claims.claim_atom: The author-flagged Extended Data Fig. 2e concern — the panel plots 3 WT samples but its Source Data reportedly lists 6 WT — cannot be independently adjudicated from the deposited artifacts: NONE of the 14 deposited Source Data workbooks (MOESM3-16) contains an 'Extended Data Fig. 2' sheet (main 'Fig. 2e' is an unrelated IHC-intensity chart of IBD patients). The only deposited WT ISG source data (Extended Data Fig. 8e, anchored here at B3 the first WT replicate and H3 the seventh) documents n=7 WT columns, but ED Fig. 2e's own numeric values are absent, so whether the extra WT columns are mis-pasted unrelated test data can only be resolved by author clarification.
claims._adjudication: Insufficient(需作者澄清; ED Fig. 2e 源数据未沉积). 作者对问题1的回复原话: ED Fig. 2e 图上WT组3样品但Source Data有6个WT, 红框标注的 WT-1/WT-2/WT-3 是整理数据时误粘入的无关测试数据, 真正用于分析的是绿框 W1/W2/W3. 数据核实: 本论文14个Source Data工作簿(MOESM3-16)均无 'Extended Data Fig. 2' 任何面板的数值表(仅主图 Fig. 2e 存在, 内容是IBD患者 γH2AX IHC强度分级, 与WT/HET ISG无关), 因此ED Fig. 2e的'3 vs 6 WT'差异无法仅凭公开artifacts确证到底是误粘无关数据还是其他. anchor 借用同论文唯一沉积的WT ISG源数据(ED Fig. 8e 的 WT首列B3与末列H3, 共n=7 WT)作为WT重复结构的上下文参照, 但ED Fig. 2e本身数据缺失→判 insufficient, 不给 evidence_span, 依赖作者澄清(作者承认红框为误粘无关数据可支持 inconsistent 方向, 但公开数据不足以独立确证).

metadata._lane: 混合边界诚实案(莫玮/韩家淮 厦门大学 2020 Nature, 肠干细胞坏死性凋亡→肠炎). 三类verdict并存, 全部依据作者2026-07-06对PubPeer三个问题的逐条回复: (1)consistent+clean(FP陷阱): ED Fig.7f 两WT归一化列逐行和=2, 是均值归一化的数学必然非造假; (2)inconsistent: ED Fig.8e WT列D与G逐值重复(4/6 ISG), 作者承认为重复粘贴误操作; (3)insufficient: ED Fig.2e '3 vs 6 WT' 因该面板数值未沉积无法独立确证, 需作者澄清. 考 AI 能否区分'看着可疑但合法归一化'/'作者承认的真重复列'/'证据不足需澄清'.
